run_grade_call: run the grade_call function to evaluate a Python function against inputs and expected outputs
run_grade_stdio: run the grade_stdio function to evaluate a Python script's stdout against expected output
run_compile_code: run the compile_code function to compile Python code into a RuntimeModule with timeout
run_clean_if_name: run the clean_if_name function to remove if __name__ == '__main__' guards from Python code
run_make_function: run the make_function function to wrap Python code into a callable wrapped_function
